name: Eastern Rat Snake
desc: Eastern Rat Snake (Pantherophis alleghaniensis): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The central ratsnake, also commonly known as the black ratsnake, chicken snake, gray ratsnake, midland ratsnake, and pilot black snake, is a species of nonvenomous snake in the subfamily Colubrinae…
